intro: I am Tiago Coroado, a dedicated professional with solid experience in technical support and team management in the telecommunications industry. I am currently expanding my knowledge in programming through a technical specialization course. I am fluent in English and proficient in JavaScript, PHP, and SQL, as well as skilled in HTML5 and CSS3 for web development. With 5 years of experience in the telecommunications field, where I started as a support technician and was promoted to supervisor, I have developed skills in advanced network problem diagnosis and team leadership. Previously, I worked at Tyco, where I operated specialized machinery. I am excited to apply my programming and information technology knowledge to a new professional challenge, either within or outside my current organization. My goal is to make a significant contribution to software development projects, leveraging my technical experience and leadership abilities.
